Care to join the team?
Looking to build your career in a team that truly invests in your growth?
 
GenesisCare Fiona Stanley Hospital is looking for a passionate Radiation Therapist to join our high performing team, working with some of the latest technology in the field.

In this role, you will play a key part in delivering high quality radiotherapy while supporting patients through every step of their treatment journey and making a real difference when it matters most.

Enjoy a full-time position with a 9-day fortnight, a Monday to Friday schedule and no weekend work. This structure gives you more time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work.

At GenesisCare, we are united by a shared purpose, delivering exceptional care and improving outcomes for our patients. Just as importantly, we are committed to supporting your growth and development, whether you are early in your career or bringing valuable experience.


More specifically, you will:

Deliver high quality radiation therapy planning and treatment in line with best practice
Perform procedures with accuracy, safety, and attention to detail
Complete required clinical documentation and administration
Maintain high standards of patient care and centre operation



We’re interested in hearing from people who:
Have strong technical capability in radiotherapy planning and treatment
Bring up to date knowledge of modern radiotherapy techniques and technology
Work well in a team environment
Are committed to delivering high quality patient care
Hold current AHPRA registration as a Radiation Therapist
Hold a current Australian Radiation Use Licence, with state requirements applying

 

Benefits of joining our team:

Work life balance you can count on, Monday to Friday roster with predictable hours
Strong earning potential, competitive salary with structured progression and regular increases
Grow your career, clear pathways into senior, specialist and leadership roles across a national network
Invest in your development, $1,500 annual professional development allowance, paid study leave and ongoing training
Modern, high impact work, access to the latest technology and treatment techniques
Generous leave offering, 5 weeks annual leave plus up to 12 weeks paid parental leave
Support that matters, wellbeing programs, confidential support services and employee perks
Join a high performing team, collaborative environment where your contribution is genuinely valued

About GenesisCare
By joining GenesisCare, you will be joining a highly progressive and passionate team of healthcare professionals and support staff, united by a common purpose: to design care experiences that deliver the best possible life outcomes. The ambition for better cancer care that began our story, has grown into a passionate team of ~2,000 employees across 50 locations nationally. Join us to design better care and enjoy a career with purpose.

GenesisCare is committed to managing the risk of transmission of specified vaccine preventable diseases (VPDs). Certain roles may require the successful candidate to show evidence that they have been vaccinated against or are not susceptible to specified VPDs.

Who We Are

Kidz Galore is a respected, local provider of childcare services, providing early childhood education for children aged 0-5 years. Established in 1995, Kidz Galore is owned by three families. As a family business, Kidz Galore retains personal touch, which we feel is most important when dealing with life’s most precious gift. Several positions available located on multiple centres across Perth region.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for passionate Early Childhood Teachers who promote children's education through their interests and plan learning opportunities therefrom. You will foster children's curiosity and create opportunities for children to grow and explore in small groups.

The ideal candidate will value the wonder of early learning within our upcycled learning environments and guide staff in providing a fun, safe, high-quality service that aligns with the National Quality Standards and is true to Kidz Galore’s reputation.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide a safe and stimulating environment that meets the social, cultural, emotional, educational and physical needs of children and promotes their agency, choices, and influence.
* Deliver effective and valuable documentation of children’s learning in accordance with the centre philosophy and the Learning Outcomes of the EYLF
* Model and support other educators to utilise a variety of teaching strategies including intentional teaching and reflective practice in daily work
* Develop and maintain respectful, supportive, collaborative and responsive relationships with children
* Facilitate and develop programs to encourage growth in communication and language skills including organizing various group-based activities.
* Liaise with families and discuss of each child’s development with parents and implementation of family support programs for early childhood development
* Attend professional development opportunities and network meeting as appropriate or as directed by director/coordinator
* Stay informed about the current trends in policy changes within the sector and assist in developing, implementing and reviewing policies and procedures in accordance with the NQS and National Law, considering confidentiality.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the service through reflective practice and the development and maintenance of the service quality improvement plan, as directed by the director/coordinator and educational leader.
* Supervise student teachers on placement if required.

Skills & Qualifications

* Relevant bachelor's degree or higher qualification (or equivalent)
* At least 12 months experience in early childhood teaching role (preferred)
* Current WA Working With Children Check (or ability to obtain)
* Current First Aid Certificate, Anaphylaxis and Asthma Management Certificate. or willingness to obtain
* Medically fit to work within a childcare environment
* Demonstrate a commitment to excellence and professional quality care
* A great work ethic and communication skills with the ability to be proactive and take initiative.
* We offer competitive remuneration based on skills and experience (salary range: $75,000 - $85,000 per annum)

If you are a motivated and qualified Early Childhood Teacher looking to join a reputable childcare and early education company, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now with your resume and relevant certifications.

An exceptional opportunity has arisen for a Vocationally Registered (VR) or restricted General Practitioner to join a thriving, state-of-the-art medical centre located in the family-friendly suburb of Burwood East, Victoria. This modern, mixed-billing clinic is situated within a bustling shopping precinct just 25 minutes from Melbourne’s CBD, offering an enviable balance of suburban charm and metropolitan convenience. With high patient demand and a rapidly growing local population, an incoming doctor will step into a fully booked schedule from day one, stepping into a vibrant practice environment that perfectly balances clinical autonomy with comprehensive organizational backing. 

 The practice boasts a highly collaborative team composition and a sophisticated infrastructure designed to optimize patient care and practitioner satisfaction. Operating with a robust support network, the incoming GP will work alongside dedicated administrative staff, experienced practice nurses, and structured Chronic Disease Management (CDM) support to streamline daily workflows. The facility is equipped with modern, spacious consultation rooms, a fully resourced treatment room, and utilizes leading software systems including Best Practice and HotDoc. Practitioners also benefit from the seamless convenience of onsite pathology and a diverse network of allied health professionals, all overseen by a supportive, GP-led leadership team. 

 Financially and professionally, this role offers an outstanding package tailored to recognize experience and dedication. The successful candidate will receive an attractive 75% of billings, alongside a generous guarantee of $200 per hour for the first three months to ensure a smooth and secure transition. For restricted GPs, the clinic provides a viable pathway through an eligible 6-month locum exemption, with broader opportunities available for those interested in exploring special interest areas, ongoing CPD support, or stepping into supervisor roles. Flexible working arrangements are highly encouraged, allowing doctors to choose between full-time, part-time, or locum commitments to suit their personal schedules. 

 Beyond the clinic walls, the location offers exceptional lifestyle benefits that make it a highly desirable place to work and live. Burwood East is renowned for its excellent community amenities, including close proximity to prestigious schooling options like Mount Waverley Secondary College and a variety of beautiful local parks and reserves. Medical networking and secondary care referrals are made easy with Waverley Private Hospital located just ten minutes away. With seamless public transport links and ample onsite parking, this position represents the ideal intersection of high earning potential, premium clinical facilities, and a vibrant, supportive community.   Apply Now

Requisition ID: CAM29006 - Surgical Skills - Unaccredited Trainee - Southern Surgical Skills Network
Located in: St George Hospital, Kogarah

Supercharge your training at St George Hospital

What you'll be doing

The primary purpose of the role is to provide effective clinical management of surgical patients, under appropriate supervision, in a complex clinical environment.

Positions in the Surgical Skills Training Networks are for junior doctors who are working towards entry into the Surgical Education and Training Program with the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons. These networked positions require rotations through several hospitals.

Where you'll be working

The Unaccredited Trainee in General Surgery position is part of the Southern Surgical Skills Network which includes St George Hospital, Sutherland Hospital and Shoalhaven District Memorial Hospital. It will be a requirement for you to be seconded to at least one of the hospitals other than St George for 3 months.

Terms on offer at in this Network are:

Colorectal Surgery (St George)

Upper GI Surgery (St George)

Trauma (St George)

SAU (St George)

Vascular Surgery (St George)

Peritonectomy Surgery (St George)

ICU (St George)

General Surgery (Sutherland)

General Surgery (Shoalhaven District Memorial Hospital, Nowra)

Nights-Evenings (St George)

Nights (Sutherland)

General Surgical Relief (St George, Sutherland, Fairfield, Campbelltown, Wollongong, Coffs Harbour, Nowra, Tweed Heads and Albury Hospitals).

South Eastern Sydney Local Health District (SESLHD) is guided by a simple vision: exceptional care, healthier lives. At St George Hospital, you'll be part of a team that delivers high-quality, compassionate care while supporting you to grow and thrive in your medical career.

St George Hospital is a major tertiary and principal teaching hospital of the University of New South Wales, with 627 beds and a reputation for clinical excellence. As a Level 1 Trauma Centre, we are leaders in trauma and emergency care, offering exposure to a broad and complex case mix. Our location near Sydney Airport also means you'll gain unique experience as part of a key first-response service to the airport precinct.

Located in Kogarah, just 14km from Sydney's CBD and close to Botany Bay, the hospital is easily accessible by public transport and major roads. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant, multicultural community, known for its great food, caf s and relaxed coastal lifestyle.

St George is a principal referral hospital providing a wide range of secondary, tertiary, and quaternary services. These hospitals have a full range of diagnostic and consultative services. The clinical year is divided into 3-month terms through which you will be rotated. There may be an opportunity to stay in a term for a 6-month period, depending on performance and popularity of the rotation.

Being part of the Southern Surgical Skills Network may mean you are required to have dealings outside the hospital with HETI and CSTC. Within the hospital the network is governed by the Network Management Committee, which meets once a term and your participation in this meeting is welcome. You will be supported by the Surgical Superintendent at St George Hospital.

10 reasons to choose St George Hospital for your training

Enjoy the best of Sydney - live near world-famous beaches, the CBD or the Inner West, all within an easy commute

Great lifestyle - caf s, restaurants and a diverse food scene right on your doorstep

Supportive team culture - approachable consultants and senior staff who are invested in your development

Real clinical experience - strong focus on hands-on learning with appropriate supervision

Modern facilities - including a brand-new ambulatory care and outpatient precinct opening in 2026

Teaching opportunities - as a UNSW teaching hospital, you can get involved in medical student education

High-acuity exposure - work in one of NSW's leading trauma and emergency centres

Dedicated JMO support - a Medical Workforce team that's responsive and here to help you succeed

Varied rotations - opportunities across multiple sites including rural and metro settings

Inclusive workplace - a strong commitment to diversity, wellbeing and belonging

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Selection Criteria

MBBS or equivalent, currently registered or eligible for registration with the Medical Board of Australia in an appropriate registration category.

Completed GSSE (or MRCS or equivalent). Completed-waitlisted a minimum of two RACS required courses; CCrISP, EMST-ATLS, ASSET, CLEAR

A professional attitude and flexibility in work role with a preparedness and ability to participate in after-hours overtime and on-call rosters.

Demonstrated commitment to the General Surgical Training Program (GSET) and evidence of progress towards and application.

Demonstrated ability to work independently within a supervised complex clinical environment utilising excellent clinical skills and judgment and expertise.

Demonstrated teamwork, time management and problem-solving skills as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Interest and ability to be involve in departmental teaching-presentation-research and student mentoring.

Our CORE Values are Collaboration, Openness, Respect and Empowerment. These values have been created by employees, for employees, and help define how we work and to inspire positive interactions in the workplace.

Additional Information

Visa sponsorship may be available for overseas candidates if no suitable permanent resident(s) or citizen(s) are identified after labour market testing.
